setupTitle.message: Two things and you are set up

setupLead.message: After this, ⌘S on a document you opened by double-clicking writes straight back to the file — no destination prompt, ever.

setupUpgradeNote.message: Upgrading and expected your folders to be here? An unpacked extension is identified by its folder path, so loading a new copy from a different folder makes it a different extension. Your folders are still granted to the old one. Replace the files in the original folder and press Reload in chrome://extensions instead.

Check for a new version when the browser starts.
One request to bento.page for a static file. It sends no identifiers, no version number and nothing about your documents — the comparison happens here. Turn it off and nothing is ever requested; Check now still works.

helpWhatSub.message: A Bento document is one HTML file that carries its own editor. Opened straight from disk, a browser will not let it write back to itself — so saving asks you where to put it, every time. bento/home is what removes that question.

tourSaveBody.message: ⌘S writes straight back to the file you opened, with no dialog. Autosave and in-place updates go the same way.

tourFindBody.message: Every Bento document in your folders, with its real title and a picture of its first page. Search covers what is written inside them.

tourSwitchBody.message: Press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>B</kbd>, or right-click inside a document, for a panel beside it.

tourNewBody.message: + New document fetches the current release of Slides, Spaces or Dash and puts a fresh document in your folder.

helpNeedsSub.message: Two things, both outside this extension’s power to arrange.

helpFolderGranted.message: $1 granted — documents inside them save in place

helpFolderNone.message: Not chosen yet. One broad folder covers everything inside it.

helpAccessOff.message: Off. Turn on Allow access to file URLs in chrome://extensions — no extension can turn this on for itself.
helpAccessOff.description: REVIEW: explains a browser permission — a mistranslation costs the user their setup.

helpAccessUnknown.message: This browser will not report it. If saves still prompt, check it in chrome://extensions.
helpAccessUnknown.description: REVIEW: explains a browser permission — a mistranslation costs the user their setup.

helpAccessOn.message: On — bento/home can read pages you opened from disk.
helpAccessOn.description: REVIEW: explains a browser permission — a mistranslation costs the user their setup.

helpNeverTitle.description: REVIEW: explains a browser permission — a mistranslation costs the user their setup.

helpNeverSub.message: It reads and writes only inside the folders above, and only the file a page was actually opened from — the browser tells it which, so a document cannot name somebody else’s file. Nothing about your documents is uploaded anywhere, and the extension has no server to upload them to.
helpNeverSub.description: REVIEW: explains a browser permission — a mistranslation costs the user their setup.

asstProvider.description: Assistant settings: label of the provider dropdown.

asstProvBuiltin.message: Chrome built-in model (Gemini Nano) — on this device

asstProvAnthropic.description: Provider option. Keep the product names.

asstProvOpenai.description: Provider option: any server speaking the OpenAI API. Keep the product names.

asstBaseUrl.description: Assistant settings: label of the endpoint address field.

asstModel.description: Assistant settings: label of the model id field.

asstKey.description: Assistant settings: label of the key field.

asstKeyOptional.message: Optional for a local server such as Ollama or LM Studio.
asstKeyOptional.description: Hint under the API key field when the OpenAI-compatible provider is chosen.

asstSaved.description: Toast after saving the assistant settings.

asstAccessDeclined.message: Site access was declined. Requests are still made, and work when the server allows browser extensions (CORS).
asstAccessDeclined.description: Assistant settings: shown after Save when the user refused the browser's site-access prompt. REVIEW: CORS is a technical term, keep it.

asstCheck.description: Assistant settings: button that makes one test request.

asstChecking.description: Assistant settings: status while the test request runs.

asstReachable.description: Assistant settings: the test request succeeded. $1 is the server's hostname.

asstBuiltinReady.description: Assistant settings: the Chrome built-in model is available.

asstBuiltinDownload.message: The model is not on this device yet. Press “Download model” in the bento/home extension’s settings.
asstBuiltinDownload.description: Assistant settings / reason: the Chrome built-in model needs downloading, and only that button starts it. Keep the button name matching asstBuiltinDownloadBtn.

asstBuiltinUnsupported.message: This Chrome has no built-in model. Choose another provider in the extension's settings.
asstBuiltinUnsupported.description: Assistant settings / reason: Chrome's built-in model is unavailable here.

asstOnDevice.description: Shown by the document as the assistant's location when the Chrome built-in model is used, in place of a server hostname.

asstNotConfigured.message: The assistant is not set up yet — open the bento/home extension's settings.
asstNotConfigured.description: Reason returned to a document when no provider, model or key is configured.

asstUnreachable.message: Could not reach $1. Is the server running, and does it allow requests from browser extensions (CORS)?
asstUnreachable.description: Reason when the request never got a response. $1 is the hostname. REVIEW: CORS is a technical term, keep it.

asstWaitConsent.message: Waiting for your permission on this device…
asstWaitConsent.description: Reason returned to a document while its permission window is still open.

asstDenied.message: Permission was refused on this device — nothing was changed.
asstDenied.description: Reason returned to a document whose permission was refused.

asstAllowedTitle.message: Documents allowed to use the assistant
asstAllowedTitle.description: Assistant settings: heading of the list of allowed files.

asstAllowedSub.message: Each document asks once before its first request. Remove one to be asked again.
asstAllowedSub.description: Assistant settings: explanation under the allowed-documents list.

consentTitle.message: Allow this document to use your assistant?
consentTitle.description: Title of the permission window a document triggers on its first assistant request. REVIEW: this is a security prompt.

consentLead.message: It will be able to send text to $1 ($2) and read the replies. Your key is never shared with it.
consentLead.description: Permission window body. $1 is the server hostname or 'this device', $2 the model name. REVIEW: this is a security prompt.

consentRemember.message: Remembered for this file. You can change it later in the extension's settings.
consentRemember.description: Permission window: note that the answer is stored per file.

consentAllow.description: Permission window: the button that grants access.

consentDeny.description: Permission window: the button that refuses access.

asstBuiltinDownloading.message: Chrome is downloading the model. Try again when it has finished.
asstBuiltinDownloading.description: Assistant settings / reason: the Chrome built-in model is downloading.

asstBuiltinDownloadBtn.description: Assistant settings: button that starts the Chrome built-in model download.

asstBuiltinProgress.description: Assistant settings: download progress. $1 is a whole number.

asstBuiltinRequirements.message: About 2–4 GB. Chrome needs roughly 22 GB free on the disk and a network that is not metered, or it reports the model as unavailable.
asstBuiltinRequirements.description: Assistant settings: hint under the built-in provider. REVIEW: the numbers are Chrome's requirements, keep them.

asstContext.description: Assistant settings: label of the optional input-window field.

asstContextHint.message: Leave empty to use what the provider reports. Fill it in for a self-hosted server whose limit only you know.
asstContextHint.description: Assistant settings: hint under the context-window field.

asstContextKnown.description: Assistant settings: the known input window of the chosen model. $1 is a formatted number.

asstShowAll.message: Show all models, not just the ones for chat
asstShowAll.description: Assistant settings: checkbox that turns off the chat-only model filter for the chosen provider.

asstOtherModelRow.description: Assistant settings: the last row of the model picker, which reveals a text field for an unlisted model id.

asstOtherModel.message: Model id, exactly as the provider names it
asstOtherModel.description: Assistant settings: placeholder of the free-text model field.

asstBadModel.message: That is not a model id: letters, digits and . _ : / - only.
asstBadModel.description: Assistant settings: shown when the typed model id has characters a model id cannot have.

asstWindow.message: The deck outline alone is too large for this model ($1 tokens; its window is $2). Choose a model with a larger window in the extension settings.
asstWindow.description: Reason returned to a document when even the outline does not fit the model's input window. $1 and $2 are formatted numbers.

asstOutlineOnly.message: Only the outline fits this model’s window, so it can change words, notes and slides but not positions or styling.
asstOutlineOnly.description: Note on an edit reply when the model's window was too small for the selection or slide JSON.

asstNoDocument.message: The document did not hand over its content.
asstNoDocument.description: Reason returned when the page did not answer the extension's request for the deck material.

asstSendsNotice.message: Sends the deck's outline and $1 to $2; comments stay here.
asstSendsNotice.description: Settings, assistant card: what leaves the machine. $1 is asstFocusGeneric, $2 the host or asstOnDeviceModel. REVIEW: a privacy statement.

asstOnDeviceModel.description: Settings: stands in for the host in asstSendsNotice when the Chrome built-in model is chosen.

asstFocusGeneric.message: the selected elements or the open slide
